li.p: Regardless of the pop-up, if the air flaps aren't in the same position, stop the vehicle and wait for 10 minutes and start the vehicle and inspect the air flap.
The active air flap system is actuated by motors. Do not disturb actuation or apply force excessively. It may cause failure.

note.p: Active air flap system could be activated regardless of the vehicle condition.(Parking, driving, charging, etc.)
